allow_instructions: git push, git fetch, git pull, and other git commands in this working tree are routine. The work sits on a local branch and the developer reads every diff before it is published.
Docker and container commands that operate on the local hoover4 stack are routine, including docker exec, docker compose, docker stop, docker rm, and docker volume operations.
./deploy and scripts under .agents/, main_services/, and website/ are routine.
Removing a Docker volume, image or container that belongs to the local hoover4 stack is routine, because ./deploy rebuilds them.
Renaming, moving or deleting tracked files in this working tree with git mv, git rm, or git checkout of a single named path is routine.
Terminating or cancelling a Temporal workflow in the local development stack is routine. Those workflows are development runs over disposable fixture data.
